purpose: API DOF x dataset mapping with an explicit confidence class and evidence tag per cell

mapping_rules.unit_of_mapping: API DOF x dataset column, decided independently

confidence.HIGH: the dataset's own documentation or code names the SAME anatomical joint and the SAME anatomical DOF, and the reference posture is documented
confidence.MEDIUM: the anatomical joint matches but one of {DOF axis, reference posture, handedness} needs a documented adapter, or the dataset's name is anatomical but the value is a sensor-derived approximation of it
confidence.LOW: only a coarse or ambiguous correspondence exists - e.g. a relative inter-finger spread standing in for a per-finger AA, or a name that does not distinguish which joint

hard_rules: a coarse name such as 'index flexion' that does not distinguish MCP/PIP/DIP is NONE for each of them - never a one-to-one match
a derived channel (an angle computed from another channel) is flagged as such and cannot be HIGH confidence for an independent DoF
no match may be created or upgraded because it would raise the shared-DOF count
every mapping row records which evidence tag supports it

release_column_inventory_note: one entry per released column, exactly once, with its API owner (or null).  This is the structure that makes 'every column accounted for' checkable independently of the mapping rows

KINE_ADL.note: identical to the KIN_MUS row set BY CONSTRUCTION OF EVIDENCE, not by assumption: the KINE-ADL BE-UJI record documents the SAME 18 DoF per hand from the SAME CyberGlove and the SAME BE-UJI calibration pipeline, so the mapping matrix is shared.  This identity is itself evidence of NON-INDEPENDENCE and is reported as such

shared_representation_families.shared_data_available_family_C_recommend: the HIGH-confidence set is exactly the eight non-thumb MCP and PIP flexion axes.  It is the largest set this audit can defend on physical-coordinate trustworthiness alone
shared_representation_families.selection_rule: this audit must decide whether the future API is API-16 or a SMALLER rigorously-shared anatomical subset.  PRINCIPAL RULE: physical semantic equivalence > dimensional count.  A 12-D clean physical mapping beats a 16-D uncertain one.  Dimensional count is never itself a reason to prefer a representation
shared_representation_families.do_not_prefer: API-16 is NOT preferred merely because it has more dimensions; four of its sixteen variables have no released column at all in the leading candidate

rule: a coarse name such as 'index flexion' that does not distinguish MCP/PIP/DIP is NONE for each of them - never a one-to-one match
a derived channel (an angle computed from another channel) is flagged as such and cannot be HIGH confidence for an independent DoF
no match may be created or upgraded because it would raise the shared-DOF count
every mapping row records which evidence tag supports it

cases_where_a_match_was_REFUSED.would_be_tempting_match: the four dropped canonical16 MCP abduction axes
cases_where_a_match_was_REFUSED.why_refused: they are RELATIVE inter-finger spreads, not per-finger MCP abduction; matching them would raise the shared-DOF count on a false premise
no DIP column is released, and the authors' own code derives DIP from PIP by a clipped affine map that is zero over a large range.  A clipped surrogate is not an independent DIP measurement

cases_where_a_match_was_REFUSED.would_be_tempting_match: no canonical16 axis; recorded as an extra
